query:
UPDATE scheduled_tasks
                       SET run_id = NULL, lease_until = NULL,
                           failures = LEAST(failures, 1000000) + 1,
                           last_finished = now(), last_result = $3,
                           next_due = LEAST(next_due, now() + make_interval(secs => $4))
                       WHERE task = $1 AND run_id = $2
